records.title: The Relation of Diet and Nutritional Factors on Altitude Tolerance, Such as Aeroembolism and Decompression Sickness. Monthly Progress Report No. 4.
records.note: The two controlled-diet columns give 59 and 67 tests, with six people described in the longitudinal diet study. Their posture, activity and condition membership vary. The 33-subject column reports one exercised test per person. Component counts disagree with two any-bends totals.
